question: Should Discord subagent progress ship with this new `channels.discord.subagentProgress` plus channel lifecycle callback, or should the branch first converge with the generic yielded-parent lifecycle contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95996?
rationale: The patch is technically credible, but automation cannot choose the permanent public config/API boundary or decide which open lifecycle branch should own parent-waiting semantics.

options.title: Converge lifecycle contracts
options.body: Rebase this Discord feature onto the agreed generic yielded-parent/subagent lifecycle seam, retaining Discord-owned rendering and configuration.

options.title: Accept this Discord seam
options.body: Approve the new channel lifecycle callback and config family as the permanent contract, then resolve conflicts and validate it independently of the broader lifecycle PR.

options.title: Pause for parent lifecycle
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader yielded-parent work lands and then restack only the unique Discord progress UI on that foundation.

recommendation.title: Converge lifecycle contracts
recommendation.body: Rebase this Discord feature onto the agreed generic yielded-parent/subagent lifecycle seam, retaining Discord-owned rendering and configuration.
